description: Set the thermal properties of the block zone constitutive model. Settings include property, expansion. Gating: requires model configure thermal. Probe trap: with any first token other than 'property' the live engine reports 'block zone thermal: command not found' (misleading - the command exists); unconfigured it reports 'Not configured for thermal calculations'.

description.7.0: Options: conductivity <f> {conductivity-x <f> | conductivity-y <f> | conductivity-z <f>}: Set thermal conductivity (isotropic). Set thermal conductivity in x direction for anistropic conductivity. Set thermal conductivity in y direction for anistropic conductivity. Set thermal conductivity in z direction for anistropic conductivity. Options: conductivity-x <f>; conductivity-y <f>; conductivity-z <f>; specific-heat <f>: Set specific heat.; expansion <f>: Set thermal expansion coefficient.
description.9.0: Set thermal properties of the block zone constitutive model. Property names (official 9.7 page; conductivity state-verified live: 'Thermal property conductivity set in 48 zones'): conductivity, conductivity-x, conductivity-y, conductivity-z, specific-heat, expansion.
